rationale: The pain is real and the willingness-to-pay benchmark is solid (Charles Proxy, Burp Suite, Proxyman all have paying userbases), but the evidence base is too thin to meet the pass threshold: a single forum post with no corroborating pain quotes, no community upvotes cited, and no competitor pricing directly tied to DOM-rewriting specifically. The buildability gate failure (score 3/10) is independently disqualifying under factory criteria. Marking rejected rather than inconclusive because the core blocker is structural (build gate), not merely evidentiary—re-queuing for evidence would not resolve the gate failure.
